resources.string: Hi, thank you for calling [enter business name]. We are currently assisting another customer and cannot answer. For bookings and information, visit [enter website URL]. Reply MENU for our automated SMS options, or leave your name and enquiry and our team will get back to you.

Hi, this is the automated SMS assistant for [enter business name]. How can we help you?
Reply:
1 - Prices and services
2 - Availability or cancellations
3 - Book an appointment
4 - Human assistance
5 - Cancel an appointment
6 - Reschedule an appointment
For bookings, availability and prices, visit [enter website URL].

6,reschedule,rescheduling,re schedule,re-schedule,change my appointment,change appointment,change my booking,move my appointment,move appointment,postpone,เลื่อนนัด,เปลี่ยนวันนัด,เปลี่ยนเวลานัด=>To reschedule your appointment, visit [enter website URL] or open your booking confirmation email and follow the link to manage or change your booking. Please make changes within our rescheduling notice period: [enter rescheduling notice period]. A fee may apply if you change your appointment outside this timeframe, in accordance with our booking policy. If you cannot make the change online, reply 4 for help. Your new appointment is confirmed only when the booking system or our team confirms it.
5,cancel,cancel my appointment,cancel appointment,cancel my booking,cancel booking,cancel my session,cancel my reservation,cancellation request,ยกเลิกนัด,ยกเลิกการจอง=>To cancel your appointment, visit [enter website URL] or open your booking confirmation email and follow the link to manage your booking. Please make changes within our cancellation notice period: [enter cancellation notice period]. A fee may apply if you cancel outside this timeframe, in accordance with our booking policy. If you cannot make the change online, reply 4 for help. Your cancellation is confirmed only when the booking system or our team confirms it.
1,price,prices,cost,costs,how much,services,service list,ราคา,ค่าบริการ=>You can view our services, appointment lengths and current prices at [enter website URL]. If you need help choosing a service or have a pricing question, reply 4 and leave your enquiry.
2,availability,available,slots,cancellations,cancellation,cancellation today,cancellations today,any cancellations,available today,today,tomorrow,คิวว่าง=>You can check current availability and any appointments that become available after cancellations here: [enter website URL]. If you cannot find a suitable time, reply 4 and leave your preferred day and time.
3,book,booking,appointment,book online,make an appointment,จองนัด=>Book your appointment here: [enter website URL]. Choose your service, date and time, then follow the booking steps. If you need help, reply 4.
4,human,human assistance,help,speak to someone,real person,call me,ติดต่อพนักงาน=>For personal assistance, please leave your name and enquiry in this SMS conversation. Our team may be assisting another customer and will respond when available.
address,location,where,directions,ที่อยู่=>Our address is [enter business address]. You can find directions and contact details at [enter website URL]. Reply 4 if you need help.
